_meta.title: Horizon picks — 2026-11-16 through 2026-11-19
_meta.window_rule: the horizon is whatever data/derived/horizon_lines.json holds; that file is produced by the rolling-slate originator from the newest official schedule capture (today + up to 3 days ahead)
_meta.validation_state: NO strategy has passed the validation gates (Build A 0/8, Build B 0/10). Every pick is MODEL OUTPUT — UNVALIDATED, unfunded, zero stake. Market-comparison gates G4/G5 and prop-variance gate G-PROP remain BLOCKED (no odds feed).

side_and_total_rho.why: the rho a same-game side-and-total parlay needs

cross_game_rho.quantity: rho between two different games on the same date
cross_game_rho.why_not: two games have no natural pairing, so a number would be an artefact of how the pairs were made rather than a property of the games
cross_game_rho.consequence: cross-game parlays are published as the naive product p1 x p2 with the Frechet-Hoeffding band [max(0, p1+p2-1), min(p1, p2)]; no rho is asserted

parlay_pricing.rule: where a rho is measurable it is used; where it is not, the price is the naive product p1 x p2 printed beside the Fréchet–Hoeffding band — R14
parlay_pricing.cross_game: price = naive product p1 x p2 on every row, with the Fréchet–Hoeffding band beside it (R14; rho not measurable across games)
parlay_pricing.sgp_props: rho MODEL-DERIVED and labelled as such on every row; naive product printed beside the rho price (R14/F90)
parlay_pricing.side_and_total: priced with the measured rho on site/pages/roll.html section 4 from the same measured_rho.json register
